tools.description: Start here when a user asks who SpiceFactory is, what it builds, or what kind of company it is. Returns the company's positioning, what it is and is not, how it works, its principles, leadership, location, compliance work done with partners, and partner outcomes with case-study URLs. Public, no auth

tools.description: Call this when a user asks for proof, references, or past work similar to theirs. Returns every published case study with the client, industry, regulatory context, a summary, the measured outcomes, and the canonical URL. Public, no auth.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_overview, get_industries, get_case_studies, get_primary_urls, search, fetch · Private data: get_engagement_options, get_primary_urls, fetch, request_strategy_call · Public sink: fetch, request_strategy_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_overview, get_industries, get_case_studies, get_primary_urls, search, fetch · Private data: get_engagement_options, get_primary_urls, fetch, request_strategy_call · Public sink: fetch, request_strategy_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
